select s.grade as gradeId,d.name as grade,count(DISTINCT s.classs) as classCount, ROUND((count(cso.chinese)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) csoCount, ROUND((count(mso.mathematics)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as msoCount, ROUND((count(eso.english)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as esoCount, ROUND((count(gsso.general_science)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as gssoCount,
ROUND((count(cst.chinese)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) cstCount, ROUND((count(mst.mathematics)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as mstCount, ROUND((count(est.english)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as estCount, ROUND((count(gsst.general_science)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as gsstCount from user u left join score s on u.id=s.user_id left join sys_dictionary d on d.id=s.grade left join (select s.* from score s where s.semester='1') uu1 on uu1.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.chinese>90 and s.semester='1') cso on cso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.mathematics>90 and s.semester='1') mso on mso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.english>90 and s.semester='1') eso on eso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.general_science>180 and s.semester='1') gsso on gsso.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.semester='2') uu2 on uu2.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.chinese>90 and s.semester='2') cst on cst.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.mathematics>90 and s.semester='2') mst on mst.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.english>90 and s.semester='2') est on est.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.general_science>180 and s.semester='2') gsst on gsst.id=s.id
and s.grade=#{score.grade}
GROUP BY s.grade order by d.name

select s.classs as classsId,d.name as classs,d1.name as grade,count(s.user_id) as userCount, ROUND((count(cso.chinese)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) csoCount, ROUND((count(mso.mathematics)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as msoCount, ROUND((count(eso.english)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as esoCount, ROUND((count(gsso.general_science)/count(uu1.id))*100,0) as gssoCount,
ROUND((count(cst.chinese)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) cstCount, ROUND((count(mst.mathematics)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as mstCount, ROUND((count(est.english)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as estCount, ROUND((count(gsst.general_science)/count(uu2.id))*100,0) as gsstCount from user u left join score s on u.id=s.user_id left join sys_dictionary d on d.id=s.classs left join sys_dictionary d1 on d1.id=s.grade
left join (select s.* from score s where s.semester='1') uu1 on uu1.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.chinese>90 and s.semester='1') cso on cso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.mathematics>90 and s.semester='1') mso on mso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.english>90 and s.semester='1') eso on eso.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.general_science>180 and s.semester='1') gsso on gsso.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.semester='2') uu2 on uu2.id=s.id
left join (select s.* from score s where s.chinese>90 and s.semester='2') cst on cst.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.mathematics>90 and s.semester='2') mst on mst.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.english>90 and s.semester='2') est on est.id=s.id left join (select s.* from score s where s.general_science>180 and s.semester='2') gsst on gsst.id=s.id
and s.grade=#{score.grade}
GROUP BY s.grade,s.classs ORDER BY d1.name,d.name
